errors.evidence: This incorrectly assigns a value to the RoBERTa model. The value 89.21% belongs to the CHSDETECTOR model. The RoBERTa model's values are 86.93% and 87.54%.

errors.evidence: This description is ambiguous and incomplete. It only mentions one of the two values for the CHSDETECTOR model (89.02%), ignoring the other (89.21%), which could mislead the reader into thinking it has only one data point.
The description introduces a calculation (mean value) that is not present in or supported by the chart itself.

errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. It incorrectly states that the category "仇恨言论" is represented by a single dark grey bar and has values of 86.93% and 87.54%. In reality, "仇恨言论" is a group of two bars, and the values 86.93% and 87.54% belong to the RoBERTa model across two different categories.

errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The category "非仇恨言论" has two bars, one dark grey (RoBERTa, 87.54%) and one light grey (CHSDETECTOR, 89.21%). The description incorrectly attributes the color and value of one model to the entire category.

errors.text_span: 默认言论的柱状图呈现着与其它柱状图相当的高度，数值为 86.93% 。
errors.evidence: The category "默认言论" does not exist in the chart. Furthermore, it incorrectly associates the value 86.93% (which belongs to the RoBERTa model for "仇恨言论") with this non-existent category.
The description fails to explain the grouped structure of the bar chart, which is essential for understanding that for each category, two models are being compared.
